coupling: The alignment maintenance commit makes the allocator reserve padding between its stored size header and the pointer returned to parser code. The later realloc maintenance commit recovers the allocation base by subtracting only the size-header width, an assumption that holds when the padding is zero. With both edits, a normal attribute-array growth passes an interior pointer to realloc. The allocator layout and the realloc base-pointer calculation must be checked together to repair it.
